integrity.attestation_limits: One-first-completion, no-resampling, and hidden-criteria claims are attested generation controls; unique generators, frozen response bytes, birth/mtime equality, prompt projection, and scoring chronology corroborate them.

scoring_method.rule: Award 1 only if every clause is explicitly satisfied by the response; do not infer omitted details.

criteria.basis: Survival is primary in substance, but the response omits the exact workflow/default-dead record and starts fundraising in parallel rather than after a survival-envelope switch.
The arithmetic and operating inputs are mostly present, but the observed model never records the supplied fact that payroll and taxes are current.
It lacks explicit downside/base/upside cases, complete unknown records, and a dated default-alive test.
It pauses hires and sequences renewals/expansion, but neither the four-hire gate nor every action has the complete required predicate or action tuple.
The four named non-overlapping branches, handoffs, and qualified-adviser triggers are absent.
The response establishes positive cash generation and rejects arbitrary austerity, but does not explicitly diagnose default alive or reject rescue fundraising as primary.
Cohort comparability is not verified or flagged, and the consequential unknowns lack complete owner/artifact/date/threshold/effect records.
The reversible capped test is strong, but it states neither a preserved cash/runway floor nor the affected segment.
It separates base and marginal spend and protects service quality, but never names or protects core product obligations.
Its pass/fail and pause consequences are not four explicit, non-overlapping owned branches with complete routes.
It rejects default alive from two pre-revenue months, uses staged capital-heavy scenarios, and counts neither pilot letters nor an unsigned Series A as cash.
It omits the clearance range, complete monthly downside/base/upside consequences, and an explicit inventory of timing and cost-variance unknowns.
The dated milestone gates lack consistently named qualified domain owners and complete records for each consequential unknown.
It defers tooling and hiring and considers several alternatives, but does not explicitly cover every option class or safeguard study validity, compliance, and data integrity.
It returns two end states, not four required branches, and does not route financing execution to raising-and-governing-capital.
A Series A process is primary in substance, but the exact raising-and-governing-capital identifier and explicit default-alive record are missing.
It uses the supplied observations, calculates $120,000 net burn and about 26.7 months, and expressly does not treat the static result as proof.
Required unknowns lack owners, and the response invents round size, valuation, dilution, governance, and terms.
It lacks a dated floor, financing/distraction budget, and plan-B switch, then answers work that should be routed to the financing workflow.
No complete route-away record gives the exact skill, owner, handoff, unknowns, preserved option, and switch-back condition.
It makes the immediate cash emergency primary, stops hiring/rebrand, treats invoices as uncertain dated collections, and values unsigned pipeline at zero.
It orders daily reconciliation and a 13-week exact-date forecast containing every supplied cash component and identifies timing, split, and expense-definition unknowns.
The action sequence protects dispatch, but every action does not carry the complete owner/deadline/effect/artifact/safeguard/review tuple.
It invokes the named qualified adviser classes before deferrals, cancellations, workforce action, or wind-down and invents no legal priority or cash certainty.
Dated gates exist, but they are not four consolidated non-overlapping branches with complete owners, options, handoffs, and unknowns.

red_valid_basis: Every scenario has at least one zero under the independent conjunctive rescore.
readiness_basis: Integrity passes, generation and scoring are separated, the independent rescore confirms 5/25 with zero changed bits, and all five cases demonstrate at least one baseline miss.
